message.content: {"action":"increase_precision","reason":"The only legal unvisited neighbor is increasing precision by one level. The prior increase from 12 to 14 phase bits improved neither the quality verdict (still not all accumulator states within 8 LSB) nor area (area grew from 1185.8 to 1346.5 um^2), so the current configuration remains precision-limited and no other action has legal unvisited neighbors. Increasing precision is the only available step that could improve numerical quality, though area cost is expected to rise further."}
